title: WNT4 acts downstream of BMP2 and functions via beta-catenin signaling pathway to regulate human endometrial stromal cell differentiation
key_use: Direct human HESC evidence for BMP2 -> WNT4/beta-catenin and decidualization; FOXO1 is a downstream mediator.

title: FOXO1 is Required for Binding of PR on IRF4, Novel Transcriptional Regulator of Endometrial Stromal Decidualization
key_use: FOXO1 is an early PKA-regulated decidual factor and is functionally required for PR genomic binding and decidual differentiation.

title: Interleukin-11 and leukemia inhibitory factor regulate the adhesion of endometrial epithelial cells: implications in fertility regulation
key_use: Primary human epithelial evidence for IL11/LIF -> STAT3, integrin alpha2, ECM adhesion; IL11 also increased trophoblast-to-epithelium adhesion.

title: Uterine SOX17: a key player in human endometrial receptivity and embryo implantation
key_use: Human endometrial SOX17 is hormone responsive; CRISPR/chemical inhibition reduced trophectoderm-spheroid adhesion.

title: The sialyltransferase ST3Gal3 facilitates the receptivity of the uterine endometrium in vitro and in vivo
key_use: ST3GAL3/sLeX perturbation altered endometrial adhesive capacity; supports an explicit glycosylation/sLeX state.

title: Sialyl Lewis X mediates interleukin-1 beta-induced trophoblast adhesion to endometrial cells during human embryo implantation
key_use: IL1B induced FUT3 and sLeX; anti-sLeX/FUT3 knockdown partially blocked trophoblast-spheroid attachment.

title: Jagged1 regulates endometrial receptivity in both humans and mice
key_use: JAG1 knockdown reduced human epithelial adhesive capacity and affected NOTCH3/HEY1 signaling.

title: miR-29c overexpression and COL4A1 downregulation in infertile human endometrium reduces endometrial epithelial cell adhesive capacity in vitro implying roles in receptivity
key_use: COL4A1 knockdown impaired epithelial adhesive capacity; supports biochemical ECM representation.

title: Impaired bone morphogenetic protein (BMP) signaling pathways disrupt decidualization in endometriosis
key_use: Patient-derived stromal/assembloid evidence for BMP/SMAD1/5/4 activity in decidualization and BMP2 rescue.
